title: Law to create business incubators for people with disabilities
summary: This bill would require the Department of Small Business Services to run a three-year pilot program with at least one business incubator site in each borough for people with disabilities who own or want to own a business. The sites would offer training, mentorship and financial resources, and connect participants to jobs. The department must report annually on the program's locations, participants and outcomes, and run a public awareness campaign.
